apps.name: OpenNOW Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Adds device-aware MetalFX resolution eligibility labels and Manual/Quality/Balanced/Performance presets showing exact stream sizes. Start a fresh session after changing resolution; codec, HDR, color and FPS are preserved. GPU NV12 range mapping fixes interpolation compatibility for existing 8-bit SDR/PQ input without downgrading 10-bit/4:4:4. Physical-device frame generation still needs testing. Unsigned iOS build, 179 tests and separate SDR/HDR Mac GPU checks passed; one simulator MetalFX skip.
